verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes a template-based site structure that can integrate additional franchise locations.
The client specifies reuse of one location-site structure with only branding and wording customized. No existing top-level key becomes obsolete.

The client requires future locations to be addable without redesign and makes branding consistent across locations; replacing the customization list retains wording while removing branding from that list.
The client explicitly designates the Seattle page as the future-location template and requires booking activation without redesign.
